description: Inspect, maintain and publish sites on the zen-webserver fleet. Read and content actions call a site's loopback admin API; publish/stop/rm/rollback are file writes that the reconciler applies, so no network listener accepts a fleet mutation.

action.description: Action to perform. Fleet mutation (publish/stop/start/rm/rollback) writes an intent file the reconciler applies; no HTTP endpoint mutates the fleet · sites: List every site the fleet knows about, with state and applied hash (read from the status document). [status file] · status: Read the fleet status document: desired verdicts, live states, recent request results. [status file] · plan: Diff desired against live without changing anything. [status file] · doctor: In-process site audit. The verify gate: a run is not complete while ok is false. [GET api/doctor] · catalog: This site's endpoint catalog: methods, suffixes, permissions, schemas. [GET api/catalog] · list: Paginated read-only inventory of articles. [GET api/list] · get: Fetch one article by exact slug. [GET api/get] · save: Create or replace one article (full document; tags/attributes are JSON strings). [POST api/save] · delete: Delete one article. Irreversible, and denied to agents unless allow-listed. [POST api/delete] · media_upload: Upload an image into the site's asset store (multipart). [POST api/media/upload] · revision_list: Revision history of one slug. [GET api/revision/list] · rename_slug: Move a slug; a redirect is recorded so the old URL keeps working. [POST api/rename_slug] · publish: Create or replace a site config through an intent file, then wait for the reconciler's verdict. [intent file] · stop: Park a site config out of the scan (nothing is deleted). [intent file] · start: Un-park a stopped site config. [intent file] · rm: Remove a site config: archived to .zen/trash, then stopped. [intent file] · rollback: Restore the newest (or a named) config snapshot through an intent. [intent file] · intents: List pending and archived intent files. [status file]

attributes.description: [save] JSON object as a string; meta_1/meta_2 live inside it, not on the article

config_file.description: [publish] path to the YAML to publish

created_after.description: [list] ISO date or datetime; only newer articles

deep.description: [doctor] also crawl every article URL (bounded, costs one render each)

expect_sha256.description: [publish] compare-and-swap: the hash of the config you read. Empty means 'must not exist yet'.

path.description: [media_upload] local file to upload; the request is sent as multipart/form-data with the field name the endpoint expects (file)

search.description: [list] substring match on title or slug

site.description: [doctor] site id (settings.site_id, or the config filename stem)

tags.description: [save] JSON array as a string (the column is TEXT), e.g. ["go","wiki"]
